# NNNN-title-in-kebab-case

| | |
|---|---|
| Status | proposed / accepted / superseded by NNNN |
| Date | YYYY-MM-DD |

## Context

What forces are at play, what problem is being solved, what constraints apply.
Link to the specs, code, or discussion that motivated the decision.

## Decision

The decision, stated as a single clear sentence, followed by supporting detail.

## Consequences

What becomes easier or harder as a result. Include the negative consequences,
not only the positive ones.

## Alternatives considered

- **Alternative A** — why it was rejected.
- **Alternative B** — why it was rejected.

## Related

- ADRs: links
- Specs: links
- Code: paths
